access.a1.summary: Users report being unable to log in, with repeated 'something went wrong' errors, false 'no internet connection' messages despite working connectivity, and being logged out unexpectedly. Reinstalling and updating did not help. A few severe
access.a1.title: Cannot log in; app shows errors or loops

access.a2.summary: Users report being unable to log in, with passwords rejected, OTPs not arriving, mobile numbers not accepted, and unexpected logouts. Some describe repeated demands for new contact numbers. One severe report describes account hacking despit
access.a2.title: Cannot log in or receive OTP

access.a3.summary: Users report being logged out unexpectedly, unable to log back in or retrieve their accounts, and losing saved or liked songs. Some describe accounts vanishing after payment changes or being hacked, with support unresponsive. A few mention
access.a3.title: Users logged out or locked out of accounts

access.a4.summary: Users report being unable to create accounts or log in, including via Google or Facebook, with errors like 'no token provided' and phone-number logins failing. Some note regional blocks (e.g., Iran) and reports of many users in Croatia hitt
access.a4.title: Unable to sign up or log in

billing.b1.summary: Users say Spotify premium costs too much, especially compared with rivals like Sirius or Tidal, and some feel it is unaffordable given local incomes. A few severe cases report being overcharged after a price increase or paying for years wit
billing.b1.title: Subscription price feels too high

billing.b2.default_name: unwanted charge or cannot cancel subscription
billing.b2.summary: Users report being charged for Spotify Premium or subscriptions despite trying to cancel, and find the cancellation process slow or confusing. Some describe the subscription policy as poor and feel the in-app subscription model is unfair; a
billing.b2.title: Unwanted subscription charges and difficult cancellation

billing.b3.summary: Users report that core features such as lyrics, song playback, and song choice have been moved behind Spotify Premium after an update, calling the app useless without a subscription. A few severe reports mention losing money after subscribi
billing.b3.title: Basic features now locked behind premium paywall

billing.b4.default_name: premium/trial not activating or payment failure
billing.b4.summary: Users report paying for Premium yet still seeing pause or upgrade screens and losing music access, plus payment problems like failed card linking, blank purchase pages, and occasional double charges. A few severe cases report losing a subsc
billing.b4.title: Paid premium not activating; payment failures

catalog.c1.summary: Users report that many songs, including underrated tracks and gospel music, are absent from the catalog, and some tracks fail to play or open different songs than selected. A few severe cases describe lost streams and favorites and inaccess
catalog.c1.title: Songs and artists missing or unavailable

catalog.c2.summary: Users report that searching for songs yields wrong or no results, and tapping a song often plays a different track. Some note hard navigation, missing music video options, and Google Assistant playing the wrong content. A rare severe report
catalog.c2.title: Search returns wrong songs or no results

catalog.c3.summary: Users say recommendations and autoplay push unwanted or 'trashy' songs, repeat the same tracks, and persist even after turning recommendations off. A few report severe frustration and wanting to quit.
catalog.c3.title: Recommendations ignore preferences and repeat songs

catalog.c4.summary: Users report lyrics not loading or showing inconsistently across songs, even after refreshing or updating. Some also cite Canvas visuals unavailable, and a few severe cases mention inaccessible playlists or podcasts.
catalog.c4.title: Lyrics fail to load or display

downloads.d1.summary: Users report offline downloads disappearing or being removed, often after phone restarts, SD card issues, or going out of data range, forcing them to re-download content. A few severe reports describe all downloaded content being wiped.
downloads.d1.title: Downloaded songs and podcasts vanish unexpectedly

downloads.d2.summary: Users report they cannot download songs, albums or lyrics, often saying downloads fail or won't start, with some premium users losing download ability and a few unable to use SD card storage or mobile data.
downloads.d2.title: Users unable to download songs for offline

downloads.d3.summary: Paying subscribers report downloaded songs and playlists failing to play offline, often requiring internet, buffering instead of playing local files, or missing playlists. Some note ignored metered-data settings and repeated temporary fixes
downloads.d3.title: Downloaded music won't play offline

other.o1.summary: Most users give brief, non-specific negative verdicts such as 'hate this application', 'worst app' or 'this app is bad', often with emojis, without naming a concrete product problem. A few severe reports allege personal data tracking and sh
other.o1.title: Generic negative rating with no specifics

other.o2.summary: Users generally praise the app as easy, fun, and high quality, with good recommendations and variety. Mild reservations mention ads, library bugs, background play, dislike of recent updates, and artist royalty rates. A few rare severe repor
other.o2.title: General praise with minor caveats

other.o3.summary: Mostly unrelated or unintelligible comments: political boycott statements (e.g., over Quran burning in Sweden), insults, and vague one-word remarks. A few rare severe reports mention data sold on the darkweb, playlists made public without c
other.o3.title: Off-topic rants and unclear short complaints

playback.p1.summary: Users report the app crashing after updates, getting stuck on the loading or logo screen, and randomly stopping mid-playback even with full connectivity. Some say it won't play anything at all.
playback.p1.title: App crashes, freezes, or stops during playback

playback.p2.summary: Users say the app shows 'no internet connection' or fails to play and download songs even though their network works fine for other apps. Some note podcast lag for premium users and failures on mobile data; a few report missing songs.
playback.p2.title: App reports no internet despite working connection

playback.p3.default_name: songs skipping, pausing or stopping by themselves
playback.p3.summary: Users report songs and podcasts stopping or pausing midway, sometimes not resuming where they left off, and occasionally refusing to play at all. Some note the problem started after an update or occurs with Bluetooth or when the screen is t
playback.p3.title: Songs stop, pause, or skip mid-playback

playback.p4.default_name: audio quality, battery or resource use
playback.p4.summary: Users report low or quiet sound quality, especially for non-subscribers, plus battery drain, background running, high data use, and app slowdowns or hangs. A few severe reports cite speaker playback failure after an update.
playback.p4.title: Poor audio quality and battery or data drain

playback.p5.summary: Users report songs will not play, playback halts or the app shuts down during listening, and offline listening or casting to other devices stops working. Some also cite bugs with music adjustment and a few complain about recent updates brea
playback.p5.title: Playback fails or stops unexpectedly

support.s1.summary: Users report support is hard to reach and slow, with long waits of hours, no answers to their issues, and poor-quality service from agents. Some severe cases mention inability to cancel subscriptions or get a phone support option.
support.s1.title: Slow or unresponsive customer support

support.s2.summary: Users report customer support is unhelpful or unreachable: canned or irrelevant replies, no place to complain or request email help, and problems left unresolved. Some describe billing and device/download issues the support team failed to f
support.s2.title: Poor support: no help, unresolved account and billing issues

usability.u1.summary: Free-tier users say ads appear far too often, sometimes every one or two songs, with repeated back-to-back ads. Some find the ads intrusive enough to push them toward premium or to uninstall; a few severe reports mention ads interrupting mu
usability.u1.title: Too many intrusive ads between songs

usability.u2.summary: Free-tier users report that they can no longer pick specific songs, skip freely, go back, replay or seek within tracks, and that shuffle is forced on playlists. Many attribute this to a recent update that moved these controls behind Premium
usability.u2.title: Free users can't choose or replay songs

usability.u3.default_name: UI, navigation, queue or playlist management
usability.u3.summary: Users report that recent updates removed or broke basic navigation and library features: search within playlists, queue management, repeat and lyrics, and recently played access. Some severe cases report liked songs or playlists failing to
usability.u3.title: Spotify UI and playlist features removed or degraded

usability.u4.summary: Users broadly say the app is not user friendly, has too many restrictions, and is hard to use after updates, including poor lyrics font and difficulty playing songs. A rarer severe sub-theme reports the UI breaking the app or songs not play
usability.u4.title: Vague usability complaints about recent app changes
